summary: First end-to-end test run for Wealth Coach MVP. Backend: all 25 pytest tests pass (auth, dashboard, accounts, transactions incl. category patch, spending, insights, goals full CRUD+contribute, budget patch, recurring, savings, investing, coach AI chat, notifications, upgrade, protected-route 401s, register+onboarding seed). Frontend: full navigation + critical flows verified via Playwright for alex@demo.com — login, dashboard (net worth, 87/100 health score 'Thriving', Athena insight, main goal, recent txns), Money (5 accounts), Account Details (56 txns), Transaction dialog + category change, Spending, Insights (3 cards + detail dialog), Goals (new goal created, count went 3->4), Spending Plan, Recurring, Savings, Investing, Ask Coach (sent 'Can I afford a $700 vacation?' and received 3 personalized AI replies referencing real numbers like $4,121 checking, $927 surplus, $6,450/$10,000 emergency fund), Notifications, Profile, Logout, protected /app redirects to /login. No critical bugs found.

design_issues.screen: Multiple dialogs (TransactionDialog, Insights detail, New Goal)
issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle / aria-describedby — accessibility warnings in console, screen readers will not announce dialogs. Wrap a visible or VisuallyHidden DialogTitle inside each DialogContent.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer briefly logs width(-1)/height(-1) warning on first render — add minHeight/minWidth to the chart container to silence and avoid rare blank chart on slow mounts.

action_items: (Minor, a11y) Add a DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden one) + aria description inside TransactionDialog, insight detail dialog, create-goal dialog to satisfy Radix a11y requirements.
(Minor) Give the Spending donut chart container an explicit min height to avoid Recharts width/height(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 683 lines containing models, auth, analytics, and all routes — consider splitting into routers/ (auth, accounts, transactions, goals, budget, coach) for maintainability.

compute_overview() runs on nearly every GET (dashboard, spending, insights, savings, budget, coach/chat) and re-reads all accounts+transactions each time — fine at demo scale, but will be a hot path; consider a short-lived cache keyed by user_id.

coach_chat inserts the user message to Mongo BEFORE calling the LLM; if the LLM errors, the user message is persisted but the fallback assistant line is also inserted — behavior is OK, but order it so both messages are written atomically after reply is produced (or wrap in try/except that still writes the fallback) to keep conversation symmetric.

CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' default is invalid per spec and will be rejected by browsers; since the app actually uses Bearer tokens, either (a) set credentials=False or (b) require an explicit CORS_ORIGINS list in prod.
No rate limiting on /auth/login or /coach/chat — brute force / cost abuse risk. Add simple per-IP throttle.
Password policy on /auth/register is unconstrained (accepts any length). Enforce min length / complexity.

clean() unconditionally pops user_id — fine, but account_details embeds the account twice via clean() and transactions already lost user_id; just note the pattern couples response shape tightly to persistence shape.
seed_data_creation: Demo data auto-seeded on onboarding POST /api/onboarding with use_demo=true (accounts, transactions, goals, budget, recurring, notifications). Verified via a freshly-registered user whose dashboard returned populated accounts and non-zero net worth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and the alex@demo.com fixture; it also registers a throwaway TEST_* user per run. The Coach AI endpoint takes ~5-10s; test timeout set to 60s. Dialog a11y warnings are logged but not blocking. All data-testid attributes used in tests are present; Notifications uses `mark-read-btn` (not `mark-all-read-btn`).
